[F012] Both i1 findings are addressed and all targeted suites are green.

**Finding 1 (high, correctness — independent harness/model resolution):** Harness and model now resolve atomically. `resolve_model` (scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/config/resolvers.py:119) gained a `harness` parameter — the agent name actually being dispatched — and a layer's model is applied only when `_expected_harness` for that layer matches it. A layer's expected harness is the name that would resolve if that layer were topmost: its own entry's name, else name resolution from that layer downward, else the goal_auditor→auditor fall-through / hardcoded fallback. This suppresses inherited models when a higher-priority layer (project over global, or a plan-level `agents_required` pick over both) changes the harness, while still letting a deeper layer's model apply when it targets the dispatched vendor. `resolve_goal_audit_model` threads `harness` through both of its lookups. All four dispatch sites now pass the resolved agent name: supervisor single-agent path (supervisor.py:1237) and `_run_round` (supervisor.py:3519), `completion_dispatch._dispatch_via_executor`, and the sufficiency-audit dispatch builder. Display/inventory callers that pass no harness keep pre-i2 behavior.
